reasonsGiven.IN.EPFO.REGISTRATION: An establishment employing twenty or more persons must be registered under the Employees' Provident Funds Act, and contributions begin from the month the threshold is crossed.
reasonsGiven.IN.ESIC.REGISTRATION: An establishment employing ten or more persons in Tamil Nadu must be registered under the Employees' State Insurance Act within fifteen days of becoming liable.
reasonsGiven.IN.FSSAI.LICENCE_STATE: With an expected turnover of INR 12,00,00,000, the business needs a State food licence. Registration applies only below twelve lakh rupees, and a Central licence above twenty crore.
reasonsGiven.IN.GST.REGISTRATION: Registration under the GST Acts is required because turnover of INR 12,00,00,000 crosses the threshold for a supplier of goods, or because the business exports.
reasonsGiven.TN.BOILERS.REGISTRATION: The vessel you describe holds 900 l, above the 22.75 litre threshold in Section 2(b), so it is a boiler and must be registered and certified before it is used.
reasonsGiven.TN.DISH.FACTORY_LICENCE: With 25 workers on the largest shift and power-driven machinery, the premises are a factory under Section 2(m) of the Factories Act, 1948, and need a licence. The threshold is ten workers where power is used and twenty where it is not.
reasonsGiven.TN.DISH.FACTORY_PLAN: With 25 workers on the largest shift and power-driven machinery, the premises are a factory under Section 2(m) of the Factories Act, 1948, and need a licence. The threshold is ten workers where power is used and twenty where it is not.
reasonsGiven.TN.FIRE.NOC: A no-objection certificate from the fire service is needed for a licensed factory, for a building over 500 square metres, or for a building 15 metres or taller.
reasonsGiven.TN.LEGALMETROLOGY.PACKER: Anyone who pre-packs a commodity for retail sale must be registered as a packer, and each package must carry the prescribed declarations.
reasonsGiven.TN.PLANNING.BUILDING_DTCP: Any new industrial building needs planning permission before construction; outside the Chennai Metropolitan Area this comes from the local planning authority under the Directorate of Town and Country Planning.
reasonsGiven.TN.TANGEDCO.HT_SERVICE: A connected load of 180 kW is supplied at high tension, which is a separate application with its own feasibility study and infrastructure contribution.
reasonsGiven.TN.TNPCB.CTE: Your activity falls in the ORANGE category, so the Board's consent is needed before the unit is established and again before it operates.
reasonsGiven.TN.TNPCB.CTO: Your activity falls in the ORANGE category, so the Board's consent is needed before the unit is established and again before it operates.
reasonsGiven.TN.UDYAM.REGISTRATION: With investment of INR 4,00,00,000 and turnover of INR 12,00,00,000, the enterprise is within the MSME limits. Udyam registration is free, takes a day, and is the precondition for almost every state and central incentive.
